# Sigmund

> Sigmund is the practice management software designed for mental health professionals in Luxembourg (psychologists, psychotherapists, psychiatrists).

## Offer

- Price: €90/month, no commitment, all-inclusive
- PID option (Immediate Direct Payment — CNS): +€45/month
- Free trial: 15 days, no credit card required

## Key features

- Calendar and scheduling, patient records, automatic invoicing in CNS format
- Automatic appointment reminders, waiting list, financial dashboard
- Prescriptions (psychiatrists), PID management, secure session notes

## Target users

Psychiatrists, psychotherapists, psychologists in private practice in Luxembourg

## Company

Hippocrate Sarl, Luxembourg | contact@sigmund.lu | Founded in 2013
